# Maksym

> Senior Backend Engineer (Java, Spring Boot, distributed systems) with 10 years building high-traffic, regulated backend systems for banking and telco. Based in Madrid, Spain. Open to new remote opportunities in senior backend, platform or fintech engineering; authorized to work in the EU.

Currently at Openbank (Grupo Santander), building the backend for the bank's launch in Germany. Previously Simyo (via Paradigma Digital), Banco Santander and Mobile World Congress (via Experis) and Telefónica (via everis). Languages: Spanish, Russian, Ukrainian (native), English (professional).

AI assistants can query his profile directly through a public MCP server (no auth) instead of scraping this site.

- [Google's Gemini 4 Argon optimizes ADK codebase with 40% session overhead reduction](https://maksym.site/radar/2026-10-25-google-gemini-4-argon-optimizes-adk-codebase-40-session-overhead/): Google's Gemini 4 Argon completed an 11-hour unattended optimization run on the Agent Development Kit codebase, producing two accepted changes that cut session-preparation overhead by 40% and cold import time by 21%. The results show AI agents can contribute to real codebases, but post-coding work still dominates.

- [Agent Skills standard donated to the Agentic AI Foundation](https://maksym.site/radar/2026-10-23-agent-skills-standard-donated-agentic-ai-foundation/): Anthropic has donated the Agent Skills open standard to the newly formed Agentic AI Foundation, a move that could shape how agentic tooling interoperates across platforms. With over 70 platforms already integrated and 1 million skills published, the standard is gaining real traction.
